title: trailboss --json checkpoint prune [FOLDER] [--yes]
description: Checkpoints of sessions that ran in a linked git worktree the repository no longer lists (removed, or pruned after its folder was deleted), one row per session. Without --yes, the plan (`would drop`); with --yes, `dropped`. Checkpoints saved in the main worktree, or in one still listed, are never dropped. Empty when there is nothing to drop.

checkpoints.description: How many of the session's checkpoints go

worktree.description: The removed worktree's folder, as the checkpoints name it
